Inclusion Criteria:
Inclusion criteria: Patients willing for the treatment

Patients of 30-70 yrs having Type-1(Non insulin dependent) with or without visual disturbances, but the detectable ophthalmoscopic features of BDR

Patient of Type-1 (Non insulin dependent) with blood sugar level, FBS- 126 to 220 mg/dl or PPBS-180 to 300 mg/dl with ongoing treatment
Exclusion Criteria:
Exclusion criteria: Patients who are extremely debilitating and those who are not able to withstand treatment procedures.

Patients of Sahaja Prameha (Hereditary).

Patients of Type-1 Diabetes or the patients of Type-2 Diabetes taking Insulin.

High Risk DR or those requiring emergency intervention.

Patients of DR with media opacities like cataract, vitreous degeneration etc. which interfere with ophthalmoscopical findings. Patients having other ocular pathologies like glaucoma, high myopia etc.

Hypertensive Retinopathy and DR associated with pregnancy.

Intervention:
Intervention1: Mukkadi Yoga, Tungadrumadi Taila, Madhumehahar Yoga, Takradhara: Preparatory phase:

ï??Deepana Pachana with Trikatu churna (2gm bd) and Luke warm water for five days.
ï??Kostha Shodhana with Kvatha (40ml) prepared with a compound containing Draksha, Taruni pushpa, Haritaki and Aragvadhamajja (compound Formulation practiced in Maharashtra for Pitta related conditions.) taken in equal quantity will be used for 3-5 days at morning time,
ï??Followed by Shiroshodhanam by Pippali and Saindhava Avapida Nasya (ref., Sharangadhar Samhita Uttarakhanda) for five days at the same time.

Treatment phase:

1.Marshya Nasya with Tungadrumadi Tail (Ref., Sahasrayogam ) for five days at morning time followed by Pratimarshya nasya with same Tail,
Monthly one sitting, Total 3 sittings.

2.Shirodhara by Siddha-Takra as medium (medicated with Musta and Amalaki) 30 minutes daily for 15 days at the morning time, Monthly one sitting, Total 3 sittings.

3.Vidalaka with Mukkadi yoga (Ref., Sahasrayogam) using Takra as medium at morning time (10 gm powder-5mm thickness of Vidalaka lepa OD for 15 days in a month). Monthly one sitting, Total 3 sittings.
Mukkadi yoga of another ongoing Study may be used for this study as Vidalaka Yoga.

4.Oral Medication (Anubhuta Rasayana yoga )
Dosage Form: capsules of 500 mg each
Dose: 6 caps/3g bd for 3 months.
Anupana: Madhu
Time of administration: Empty stomach, before breakfast in the morning and before dinner in the evening with the advice not to take anything orally for an hour except hot water.
All the above therapies will be continued along with Anti-hyperglycemic treatment as advised by the treating physician.

Intervention:
Intervention1: Ayurvedic treatment protocol for BDR starting from Deepana pachana,sadhya snehana ,koshtasodhana,shodhana and samana nasya,sirolepa and oral rasayana drug.: deepana pachana -Trikatu churna/chitrakadi vati 5g/2 tab bd for 3 days orally.sadya sneha orally with saindhava yuktha goghrita in the evening for a day Koshta sodhana kwatha containing Draksha,hareetaki,taruni pushpa and aragwadha majja(Planned) in equal quantity orally (5 g each with 160 ml water reduced to 40 ml) for 1-3 days depending on koshta in the morning time(kapha pitta kala) Pippali saindhava avapeedanasya (3 g+5 ml water and 4 drops to each nostril) in the morning time for 3 days-transnasally.shamana nasya with drakshadi ghrita(A.H UTTARASTHANA 13/4) 8 drops per nostril for 7 days -2 sitting in 2 months.sirolepa with mukkadi sirolepa yoga(sahasrayoga netraroga prakarana) for 21 days of 2 sitting-transdermal. Oral rasayana drug containing Nisa,Mamalaki,Guduchi,Mustha,Bala,Yashtimadhu,Bhringaraja,Vasa and chitraka (planned yoga with all others 1 part each and purified chitraka 0.5 part )3 g bd in empty stomach for 2 months and honey as adjuvant.(anupana)total thrapy fo 2 months.
Control Intervention1: Anti-hyperglycemic treatment.: 20 patients already under anti-hyperglycemic treatment by their respective physicians will be taken for observation through out the interventional period.
